Given the apparent disinformation we have received from LegionWill in regards to a host of topics, I'd like to go over purported claims that the block was purchased by the Saudis for $0. I posted this on another thread, but I feel it may get lost in the clutter, so lets lay out a few facts and go through this particular claim.

The block was in fact purchased on the same day, and by the same companies, or at least listed as such. CON NEB LiC, and a property management company based in Northern Virginia (H.A. Gill). As far as the block being sold for $0, that's how it appears in real estate databases. In the DC government property queries, the sales price appears as "unavailable". In order to confirm this, please go to https://corp.dcra.dc.gov , create an account, and do a search on each of these properties.

I talked to a family member who worked commercial real estate in DC - and she said that reports like that aren't that uncommon. It may be that they simply failed to report to the agencies what the actual sales price was, possibly a transfer of title from an older version of a company to a newer (perhaps a restructure), possibly the addition of the management company on the title, or one of a number of other things. Some possibilities are more suspicious than others. I should also add that selling an entire block is actually very common practice in DC.

CONNEB II LLC appears to be a company registered in Vienna, VA. You can see the listings here:

https://opencorporates.com/companies/us_va/S0880338

https://sccefile.scc.virginia.gov/Business/S0880338

H.A. Gill at least has a website: http://www.hagill.com/ They manage and sell property in DC.

The location is a single family home. I'd swing by and check out who it is, but the house was sold in October. The registered agent for the company was a "Kevin McCarthy". This could be the actual agent, or the owner of the LLC representing himself as an agent. The business entity claims an alternate address at H.A Gill (the aforementioned property management company) There are a few notable Kevin McCarthy's in the area. One is a US congressman from California. Another is a man who works investment brokerage for AFL-CIO (interesting). Another is a doctor with his own clinic in Bethesda, MD.

CON NEB II LLC could very well be an independent property investor using an LLC to manage his taxes, a company set up so that a handful of people could invest in the block, or as a means for foreign investors to own American property. We have no idea.

TL;DR: The ownership of this block is registered to two American companies, one being an established property management company, and the other may very well be just a handful of investors (foreign or domestic). There is no evidence of Saudi involvement. There is also no proof that the block was sold for $0, and we cannot ascertain what event led to the particular listing as such.
